name: Milo gets silly when he is in love!
source:
Moka was just a chill girl, living her life like a regular person. That's untill she got abducted by her secret admirer - Milo. It doesn't seem like she knows him at all! Will you be kind enough to help her?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250722232512/https://sdf0aabd.itch.io/milo-gets-silly-when-he-is-in-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
莫卡原本只是个随性自在的女孩，和普通人一样过着平淡安稳的日子——直到她被自己的神秘暗恋者米洛绑架为止。偏偏她好像压根就不认识这家伙！你愿意大发慈悲出手帮帮她吗？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250722232512/https://sdf0aabd.itch.io/milo-gets-silly-when-he-is-in-love]itch.io[/url]]
